alt_text: A woman whose skin and hair are polished grey-ivory marble sits upright on a brownstone stoop in a blush one-shoulder top and olive trousers, looking down at a fawn Great Dane, a black poodle and a corgi sitting on the steps below her, all three looking up at her; autumn leaves on the steps.
